effect_description_eng:
[Main] ＜Draw 2＞ (Draw 2 cards from your deck.) and trash 2 cards in your hand. Then, place this card in the battle area.
[Your Turn] When any of your [Titan] trait Digimon are played, ＜Delay＞ (By trashing this card after the placing turn, activate the effect below.)
・If your opponent has 5 or more memory, you may play 1 level 5 or lower Digimon card with the [Titan] trait from your trash without paying the cost.
inherited_effect_description_eng: Security Effect [Security] You may play 1 level 4 or lower [Titan] trait Digimon card from your hand or trash without paying the cost. Then, add this card to the hand.
